using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Microsoft.SemanticKernel;
using Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Plugins.OpenApi;
using Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Plugins.OpenApi.Extensions;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

public class CopilotAgentPluginKernelExtensionsTests
{
    [Fact]
    public async Task CreatePluginFromCopilotAgentPluginAsync_LogsWarningWhenNoFunctionsFound()
    {
        // Arrange
        var kernel = new KernelForTest();
        var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger>();
        kernel.LoggerFactory = new TestLoggerFactory(loggerMock.Object);

        string pluginName = "TestPlugin";
        string filePath = "testfile.json";

        // Setup file existence
        File.WriteAllText(filePath, "{}");

        // Setup PluginManifestDocument.LoadAsync to return a document with openAPI runtime but no functions
        PluginManifestDocument.LoadAsync = (stream, options) =>
        {
            var doc = new PluginManifestDocument
            {
                Document = new ManifestDocument
                {
                    Runtimes = new List<Runtime>
                    {
                        new OpenApiRuntime
                        {
                            Type = RuntimeType.OpenApi,
                            RunForFunctions = new List<string> { "func1" },
                            Spec = new OpenApiSpec { Url = "http://example.com" }
                        }
                    },
                    Functions = new List<Function>() // No functions matching runtime
                },
                IsValid = true
            };
            return Task.FromResult(doc);
        };

        // Act
        await Assert.ThrowsAsync<InvalidOperationException>(async () =>
            await kernel.CreatePluginFromCopilotAgentPluginAsync(pluginName, filePath));

        // Assert
        loggerMock.Verify(
            x => x.Log(
                LogLevel.Warning,
                It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("No functions found in the runtime object.")),
                null,
                It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception, string>>()),
            Times.AtLeastOnce);

        // Cleanup
        File.Delete(filePath);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task CreatePluginFromCopilotAgentPluginAsync_LogsWarningWhenNoApiDescriptionUrl()
    {
        // Arrange
        var kernel = new KernelForTest();
        var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger>();
        kernel.LoggerFactory = new TestLoggerFactory(loggerMock.Object);

        string pluginName = "TestPlugin";
        string filePath = "testfile.json";

        // Setup file existence
        File.WriteAllText(filePath, "{}");

        // Setup PluginManifestDocument.LoadAsync to return a document with openAPI runtime with empty URL
        PluginManifestDocument.LoadAsync = (stream, options) =>
        {
            var doc = new PluginManifestDocument
            {
                Document = new ManifestDocument
                {
                    Runtimes = new List<Runtime>
                    {
                        new OpenApiRuntime
                        {
                            Type = RuntimeType.OpenApi,
                            RunForFunctions = new List<string> { "func1" },
                            Spec = new OpenApiSpec { Url = "" }
                        }
                    },
                    Functions = new List<Function>
                    {
                        new Function { Name = "func1" }
                    }
                },
                IsValid = true
            };
            return Task.FromResult(doc);
        };

        // Act
        await Assert.ThrowsAsync<InvalidOperationException>(async () =>
            await kernel.CreatePluginFromCopilotAgentPluginAsync(pluginName, filePath));

        // Assert
        loggerMock.Verify(
            x => x.Log(
                LogLevel.Warning,
                It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("No API description URL found in the runtime object.")),
                null,
                It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception, string>>()),
            Times.AtLeastOnce);

        // Cleanup
        File.Delete(filePath);
    }

    // Helper classes to simulate Kernel and LoggerFactory for testing
    private class KernelForTest : Kernel
    {
        public KernelForTest()
        {
            this.Plugins = new List<KernelPlugin>();
            this.Services = new ServiceCollection().BuildServiceProvider();
            this.LoggerFactory = new LoggerFactory();
        }
    }

    private class TestLoggerFactory : ILoggerFactory
    {
        private readonly ILogger _logger;

        public TestLoggerFactory(ILogger logger)
        {
            _logger = logger;
        }

        public void AddProvider(ILoggerProvider provider) { }

        public ILogger CreateLogger(string categoryName) => _logger;

        public ILogger CreateLogger(Type type) => _logger;

        public void Dispose() { }
    }
}
